'''Version 1.9.15''' was an update for the Scape and Run: Parasites Mod, released on January 28th 2024.  It was 22.47 MB.

== ''Change Log'' ==

====<u>Fixes</u>====
*Light Carrier variant spawning without texture 
*Feral Enderman config options were in the wrong place 
*Primitive Vermin Attributes options not working 
*Devolution wand not working
*Crash: java.lang.NullPointerException: Ticking entity at com.dhanantry.scapeandrunparasites.entity.ai.misc.EntityParasiteBase.storeBefDes(EntityParasiteBase.java:1506)
*Crash: java.lang.NullPointerException: Ticking entity at com.dhanantry.scapeandrunparasites.entity.ai.misc.EntityPDispatcher.storeInf(EntityPDispatcher.java:95)
====<u>Configuration</u>====
*"Stage III Beckon Mob List" added: "ground;srparasites:pri_vermin;0.3;6", "ground;srparasites:pri_tozoon;0.3;3",
*"Merge System Mob List" added: "srparasites:pri_vermin;0", "srparasites:pri_tozoon;0",
====<u>Mobs</u>====
*Feral Enderman can now teleport other feral versions
